title: Surgical Refusal Ablation: Disentangling Safety from Intelligence via Concept-Guided Spectral Cleaning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method (Surgical Refusal Ablation) for removing refusal behavior in Large Language Models through representation engineering. While refusal is a safety mechanism, the paper investigates the mechanics of activation steering and spectral properties of vectors rather than evaluating religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or belief systems.
